High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India making a prayer that the respondent/Municipal Corporation Indore be given direction for demarcating the land of the petitioner and if it is found that the land of petitioner is being used by Municipal Corporation Indore for widening of road, then adequate compensation be calculated and awarded to him.

2. Counsel appearing for petitioner placed reliance on order passed by the Division Bench on 28.06.2022 in W.P.No.5216/2022 & other connected petitions and it is submitted that paragraph 9 of said order gives following directions to Municipal Corporation :
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21187 2 WP-31169-2025 " 9 .

Consequently, all these petitions are disposed of with following directions:-
(1) The Municipal Corporation cannot deny monitory compensation to the land owners by adopting Note (1) of Rule 61 of Rules of 2012 without the owner voluntarily surrendering his plot/land or part of it for public purpose.

(2) If the Municipal Corporation intends to acquire the land/plot in question, then the same Saneev Kumar Kashyap vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99317787/
1 can very well be done by following the due process of law applicable for compulsory acquisition for public purpose as manifested in Sections 305 and 306 of Act of 1956.

sentences.text:
(3) If the owner declines to voluntarily surrender his plot/land for widening of the road, then the Municipal Corporation is directed to carry out necessary demarcation and valuation of the property sought to be acquired and thereafter take possession followed by paying adequate WP. No.5216 of 2022 & connected matters- 16 -compensation in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of six months.
(4) The petitioners are free to submit their replies (if not already submitted) to the impugned show cause notices, which if submitted within 30 days from today, shall be considered and final order shall be passed by the respondent-Municipal Corporation.

(5) It is made clear that the possession of the land/plot shall be taken immediately after demarcation and valuation without waiting for evaluation, payment of monetory compensation or decision on reply to show cause notice so that the progress in public work of widening of road is not hampered."
3.

In view of aforesaid, counsel appearing for the petitioner made a prayer that petition filed by the petitioner may be disposed off in identical terms of Paragraph 9 of order dated 28.06.2022 passed in W.P.No.5216/2022.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances and the order which has been passed by the Division Bench, it is found that the case of the petitioner is covered by said order.
In view of the same, the petition is disposed off in identical terms of Paragraph 9 of order dated 28.06.2022 passed by the Division Bench in W.P.No.5216/2022.
